message: The run-time identifier '{0}' was not declared in the template. This can be caused by an error in the template or by a defect in Metalama.
title: The run-time identifier was not declared.
rationale: The message says 'defined' while the title says 'declared', and it gives no way forward. The report site (TemplateCompilerRewriter.TransformIdentifierToken) is only reached when a local symbol referenced by the template has no known declaration, which happens only in an incorrect compilation or through a Metalama defect. The title also lacks the final period.
